data.name: Niteesh
data.gender_notes: Niteesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Niteesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'niti' (rules, principles) and 'isha' (lord). It refers to the lord who guides and protects during the night. In Hindu mythology, Niteesh is also identified with the god Shiva, who is often referred to as the 'Lord of the Night'. The name Niteesh carries the meaning “Lord of the night” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Niteesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the night and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes protection, guidance, and the power of the divine during the night.
data.etymology: Niteesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the night.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niteesh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

historical_references.context: Another belief suggests that the name 'Niteesh' is a variant of the name 'Narayan', with the prefix 'Nite' meaning 'night'. The name 'Niteesh' is thus believed to signify this idea.
